unitspec_directory.digest_rule: sha256 over name-sorted lines '<file>\t<sha256>\n' for every *.xml

purpose: Deterministic map from each help device-dialog candidate to exact unit types, catalogue/firmware ranges, statically registered unit classes and node managers, dialog-director forms and the most specific feature-ledger row. Identification only: no control, parameter, original-differential or physical acceptance.

unit_factory.method: Static decode of every call to TUnitTypeFactory.RegisterUnitType and TUnitNodeManagerFactory.RegisterNodeManager: factory singleton in EAX, VMT class reference in ECX, constant UnicodeString type in EDX and pushed minimum/maximum firmware strings; class names read from the VMT.
